create_captured_function: create a captured function wrapper that injects config, logger, and randomness arguments into a callable
apply_captured_function_decorator: apply the captured_function wrapt decorator to a function to auto-inject config and seed arguments on call
review_create_captured_function: review the create_captured_function factory that attaches signature, randomness, and config metadata to a function
review_captured_function_decorator: review the captured_function wrapt decorator that constructs arguments from config and logs execution timing
test_captured_function_with_randomness: test the captured_function decorator to verify it injects _seed and _rnd when the wrapped function requests them
